name: Sultan Abdul Aziz Shah Airport (Subang)

runway.v: one runway, 15/33, 3,782 m long and 45 m wide

customs.v: customs and immigration from 07:00 to 23:00 local time (2300-1500 UTC)

hours.v: aerodrome open 24 hours; terminal building 05:00 to 24:00 local time (2100-1600 UTC), outside that on 24 hours' prior permission from Malaysia Airports; scheduled commercial jets only 06:00 to 22:00 local (2200-1400 UTC)
hours.quote: AD Operator: H24 ... Terminal building OPR BTN 2100 - 1600. Outside this time, terminal building available on 24 hr PPR from Malaysia Airport Sdn. Bhd. ... Scheduled commercial jets operations hours are between 2200 - 1400 only.

handling.v: by arrangement with an authorised handling agent (no agents named in the AIP)
handling.quote: By arrangement with authorized handling agent.

max_aircraft.v: stands on taxilane P1 at bays 1-4 and 13-14, and on taxilane N1 at bays 11-12, are limited to aircraft with a wingspan of 28 m or less
max_aircraft.quote: Aircraft stand taxilane P1 from Bay 1 until Bay 4 and Bay 13 until Bay 14 is restricted for aircraft wing span 28 m and below. ... Aircraft stand taxilane N1 from Bay 11 until Bay 12 is restricted for aircraft wing span 28 m and below.

slots.v: under civil non-scheduled flights, the AIP says airlines must get slot time confirmation from National Slot Coordination Malaysia (NSCM) before applying to CAAM; it says 'airlines' and does not mention private aircraft separately
slots.quote: All airlines operating to all airports in Malaysia must contact National Slot Coordination Malaysia (NSCM) for slot time confirmation in IATA SCR format before submitting to CAAM

permits.v: non-scheduled flights need prior permission through NOSAS or AEROFILE; apply at least 3 working days ahead or approval may not be processed in time
permits.quote: Prior permission must be sought and obtained either by NOSAS or AEROFILE system.; Flight approval might not be processed in time if the application is less than three (3) working days.

missing: curfew (no night restriction for business aviation stated)
notes: AIP times are UTC; Malaysia is UTC+8 with no DST, so conversions are fixed. A later edition (AIRAC 6 Aug 2026 / 11 Aug 2026) exists but its WMSA page could not be opened; facts are from the 19 May 2026 edition. Slots for all Malaysian airports are covered at country level (GEN 1.2, NSCM). 1 Nov 2026: re-read the newest edition, AIRAC 29 Oct 2026: runway, customs (2300-1500 UTC = 07:00-23:00 local), terminal hours and noise unchanged; added the N1 stand limit and the hours for scheduled commercial jets (2200-1400 UTC = 06:00-22:00 local; the AIP sets no such limit for non-scheduled or business flights). AD 2.20 has no curfew, slot or PPR text for business aviation, but does not say 'no curfew', so curfew stays missing. Also in AD 2.20: taxiways D, J, L and M are for day operations only; aircraft without two-way radio need prior permission; departures may be regulated at peak hours. AD 2.4 remarks now read 'NIL'; the handling line is kept from the 19 May 2026 edition. | 2026-11-02 run: Nothing new; no further source searched. | 2026-11-04 run: 4 Nov 2026: slots and permits added from GEN 1.2 (eAIP 11 Aug 2026; a newer GEN 1.2 was not found). AD 2 not re-read. | 7 Nov 2026: nothing added.
